name: Mood Board
allowed_jobs: write a brief and confirm it with the user
have Zara crop real UI elements from live sites into a sectioned collage
read real colours, fonts, radius and spacing from each source page
collect persona votes on each tile as advice
open the visual board for the user to keep / maybe / reject
send Zara back with the user's notes
lock the user's direction into the session for every persona
keep the older link-and-tag board (kind mood)
forbidden_jobs: replace the design-critic chain for screen review
record a user decision the user did not make
let a persona vote override the user's choice
add a tile without its source page
